WITH district_counts AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        d.A3 AS region,
        COUNT(*) AS client_count
    FROM disp AS dp
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A3
),
shares AS (
    SELECT
        district_id,
        region,
        client_count,
        1.0 * client_count / SUM(client_count) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS region_share,
        1.0 * client_count / SUM(client_count) OVER () AS overall_share
    FROM district_counts
)
SELECT district_id, region, client_count, region_share, overall_share
FROM shares
ORDER BY overall_share DESC, district_id
LIMIT 10
